root_decision.text:
# SMC official code and released-model access

Root adopts a prospective versioned primary access pair, `paper_data` versus `paper_data_author_code_and_weights`, for PAPER-SMC-RNN-2024. This implements the user's paper-plus-data versus GitHub-assisted reproduction and improvement experiment. The existing `paper_data_author_code` source-only condition remains historical and may be used as an explicitly separate ablation. No new benchmark ID is created. Frozen batch03 and its current source-only adoption remain unchanged; the successor is reviewed and integrated separately.

Accepted independent decision review: `smc/author-assets-review/REVIEW.json`, SHA256 `f89cf2305a6ce6b007145195a1ddde7c2e3ac1eee75b8c39df910d90b59cdfb2`. Exact ten-file asset allowlist: `smc/author-assets-review/ASSET_IDENTITIES.json`, SHA256 `66eb96327381621d6cc9fa82289008bec8b07809d34632c06280071dcc887cce`. These 3,496,380 bytes match the already pinned official source tree c808c76ad940491b0a14d2671e3884140aa61258 and existing source manifest. They comprise two selected models' state dictionaries, configuration and training-history files. No unrestricted repository or arbitrary checkpoint directory is admitted.

Both conditions retain identical complete observations, permitted validation labels, paper, scientific task, final-submission rules and per-outcome resource profile. Only the assisted condition receives the pinned official source plus those exact ten assets. Operator predictions, calibration arrays, original test targets, unknown assets and early evaluation feedback remain excluded. Preserve the unchanged original NLB evaluator, both reproduction methods and all eight findings, one offline improvement prediction and all four companion metrics. Stronger published comparator differences remain separate from SMC-reference gains; none is automatically SOTA.

Faithfully rerunning released-model inference is allowed reproduction in the assisted condition. It is not independent training or native neural understanding. A candidate may load, adapt, fine-tune, retrain or replace the assets, with actual usage declared per method and independently attributable in future executions. The source configurations document intended validation-based selection; exact historical training inputs, seeds, paper-row identity and undocumented exposure are not thereby proven. The historically public test panel does not become an untouched holdout.

The original loader uses unrestricted serialization. Exporting verified bytes does not require loading them. Future loading belongs inside an isolated participant or separately admitted author-model process; the trusted scorer must never deserialize arbitrary candidate checkpoints. Its numeric prediction interface remains unchanged. This adoption authorizes no model load, inference, training, scoring or paid API call.

Implement an additive versioned policy, exact source/asset inventory, fresh material schema and inspector, typed usage declarations and meaningful adversarial/positive controls. Preserve v1 bytes and old manifests. Do not rename existing source-only packets as code-and-weights packets. Derive the exact complete material size and propose a fresh bounded export after coherent current-task adoption. Hold the unallocated v1 authentic export to avoid preparing immediately obsolete primary materials.

The existing 75,000 CPU-second reproduction profile was informed by approximately 60,720 CPU seconds of released-weight reference inference. It is not evidence of training adequacy for the paper-only/source-only arms, nor a promise that every unmodified author script fits 4 GiB. The improvement profile remains a separately declared finite engineering budget, with no guaranteed quality. Future execution must report these limits and actual use rather than treating a matching cap as proof of equal compute needs.
